objective: Inspect installed CodeSnap and global Zed configuration and determine the smallest reliable global screenshot task integration.
scope: Read local Zed settings, themes, existing tasks and installed codesnap CLI/version/help; inspect official Zed task variables and CodeSnap configuration documentation where necessary.

Return exact user configuration paths, current appearance settings, command interface, task input and quoting strategy, limitations, and recommended implementation. Read-only except temporary probe output outside repository.
constraints: User asks: setup codesnap-rs/codesnap (already installed on the machine) in a global zed task so I can take screenshots of code with the editor's colorscheme, fonts, etc; don't care about the lexical token differences.
Preserve settings/tasks; no edits to repository, version-control writes, security configuration or global installation changes.
Use FFF file search when available; if absent report setup limitation and use direct reads.
Report in at most 8 bullets; put long logs outside the repository and give the path.
result:
result: Smallest reliable integration is one global Zed task invoking CodeSnap on the active file; no configuration was changed.
changed: none
checks: `codesnap --version` -> exit 0, `codesnap-cli 0.14.0`; `codesnap --help` -> exit 0, supports `--from-file`, `--output`, `--code-font-family`, `--code-theme`, `--config`; snapshot probe -> exit 0, saved a 527,475-byte SVG.
blockers: none
questions: none
notes: CodeSnap does not inherit Zed’s editor theme or fonts automatically; matching them requires explicit CodeSnap theme/font settings. It renders a snapshot, not a pixel-accurate capture of Zed.
evidence:
Integration facts (behavior): Installed at `C:\Users\david.basile\.cargo\bin\codesnap.exe`; `codesnap --from-file "$ZED_FILE" --output clipboard` is a simple task command. Prefer task `args` (`["--from-file", "$ZED_FILE", "--output", "clipboard"]`) to protect paths with spaces; alternatively use a quoted variable in the command. Zed exposes `$ZED_FILE`. A clipboard destination avoids a fixed output file collision; the task is manually run on the active file.
Appearance mapping (behavior): `C:\Users\david.basile\AppData\Roaming\Zed\settings.json` sets theme mode `system`, light `One Light`, dark `One Dark`, and `buffer_font_size: 15`; no buffer font family is specified. CodeSnap provides independent `--code-theme` and `--code-font-family` options but no evidence of automatic Zed setting/theme integration. Set them explicitly to chosen equivalents; exact colors and font may need manual matching.
Preserved scope (scope): Read-only inspection; existing settings left unchanged, no global tasks file exists at `C:\Users\david.basile\AppData\Roaming\Zed\tasks.json`. Zed documentation identifies global tasks in `~/.config/zed/tasks.json` and supports opening them via `zed: open tasks`; on this machine use Zed’s action to confirm its platform-specific location.
